data.description:
## testing_mode: GREEN

## What
Create plugins/dso/scripts/check-unacked-degradations.sh (chmod +x). Make all 8 tests from T1 pass. Update .test-index: remove T1 RED markers, add normal source:test mapping.

## Script Logic (story_id as $1)
1. Header comment: '# Must be called before dso:completion-verifier dispatch in sprint Step 18'
2. Resolve TICKETS_TRACKER_DIR from env var or git rev-parse --show-toplevel
3. ticket_dir="$TICKETS_TRACKER_DIR/$story_id"
4. Pre-manifest exemption: if no *-PRECONDITIONS.json files in ticket_dir → exit 0 silently
5. Collect degradation decision_ids: for each *-PRECONDITIONS.json file, if data.degradation == true, collect each element of data.decision_ids array
6. ACK event format (AUTHORITATIVE INLINE SPEC — created by e959-9703 T3 as ack-event-format.md): file suffix is -ACK.json; JSON object with field 'decision_ids' (array of strings), 'schema_version' (int), 'if_skipped' (string), 'timestamp' (ISO8601), 'sampled_set' (nullable array). Example: {"decision_ids":["sess:abc123"],"schema_version":1}
7. Collect acked decision_ids: for each *-ACK.json file in ticket_dir, collect each element of the decision_ids array
8. Unacked = set(degradation_decision_ids) - set(acked_decision_ids)
9. If unacked non-empty: echo each unacked decision_id on its own line (one per line format required); exit 1
10. Else: exit 0
11. Error handling: malformed JSON in any file or missing ticket_dir → exit 0 with stderr warning (fail-open). Use python3 for JSON parsing.

## .test-index Update
- Remove all 8 RED markers added by T1 (format: plugins/dso/scripts/check-unacked-degradations.sh:tests/scripts/test-check-unacked-degradations.sh [test_name])
- Add: plugins/dso/scripts/check-unacked-degradations.sh:tests/scripts/test-check-unacked-degradations.sh

## Acceptance Criteria
1. Universal: test suite passes
   Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh (or targeted: bash tests/scripts/test-check-unacked-degradations.sh)
2. Script is executable
   Verify: test -x plugins/dso/scripts/check-unacked-degradations.sh
3. All 8 tests pass
   Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-check-unacked-degradations.sh
4. Pre-manifest exemption (no-events → exit 0)
   Verify: TICKETS_TRACKER_DIR=tests/fixtures/degradations bash plugins/dso/scripts/check-unacked-degradations.sh no-events; test $? -eq 0
5. Unacked detection (one-unacked → exit 1)
   Verify: TICKETS_TRACKER_DIR=tests/fixtures/degradations bash plugins/dso/scripts/check-unacked-degradations.sh one-unacked; test $? -eq 1
6. Fail-open (malformed JSON → exit 0)
   Verify: TICKETS_TRACKER_DIR=tests/fixtures/degradations bash plugins/dso/scripts/check-unacked-degradations.sh fail-open; test $? -eq 0
7. RED markers removed, normal mapping present
   Verify: ! grep -q 'check-unacked-degradations.sh:tests/scripts/test-check-unacked-degradations.sh \[test_' .test-index && grep -q 'check-unacked-degradations.sh:tests/scripts/test-check-unacked-degradations.sh' .test-index
data.title: Implement check-unacked-degradations.sh and update .test-index
